source: Yaesu FT-991A CAT Operation Reference Manual, file FT-991A_CAT_OM_ENG_1711-D.pdf (sha256 52164f73...0c95). Written fresh from that document.
frame: two-letter command, fixed-width parameters, terminator ';' (pdf page 3). Read = command with no parameters; Answer = same layout as Set.

commands.name: information
commands.params: P1 3 ch, P2 9 freq, P3 5 clar, P4 rx clar, P5 tx clar, P6 mode, P7 vfo/mem, P8 ctcss, P9 2 fixed, P10 shift

commands.name: mode
commands.params: P1 0 (main), P2 1 LSB 2 USB 3 CW-U 4 FM 5 AM 6 RTTY-LSB 7 CW-L 8 DATA-LSB 9 RTTY-USB A DATA-FM B FM-N C DATA-USB D AM-N E C4FM

commands.name: memory_read
commands.params: read MR P0(3); answer MR + same layout as IF

commands.name: memory_write_tag
commands.params: P1 3 ch, P2 9 freq, P3 5 clar, P4, P5, P6 mode, P7 0, P8 ctcss, P9 00, P10 shift, P11 0, P12 12-char tag

commands.name: read_meter
commands.params: P1 meter (1 S, 4 ALC, 5 PO, 6 SWR), P2 3 digits 000-255

commands.name: tx_set
commands.params: P1 0 RX, 1 radio TX (answer only), 2 CAT TX
